featured_reviews.name: Adv. Prasad Jagtap
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a disappointing experience with Jeevan Cleaners recently. I took a brand new shirt for ironing, but when I returned the next day to pick it up, I was given the shirt with a lot of dust all over it. When I inquired about the dust, the staff/owner rudely explained that there was ongoing construction in the area, and if I wanted a shirt without dust, I should iron it myself at home.

What struck me as unprofessional was that despite knowing the area was dusty due to the construction, they didn't make any effort to cover the clothes or protect them from the dust. This lack of care and the rude response left a bad impression. There was a clear attitude from the staff that they were doing a favor by ironing customers' clothes, rather than providing a service.
This kind of treatment and lack of customer service has convinced me that I won't be returning.

- After I lost my cool and lodged a complaint with their Customer Care (which too was completely useless) they started seriously looking for it.
- Guess what, they realised that they are misplaced my item. Remorseless faces just giving me blank stares. The star of the entire debacle was Ms. Meena Purohit. Extremely careless, arrogant and ignorant of the severity of the issue.
- After I created a ruckus, they realised they had misplaced the Sherwani in the Dahisar Store!!

I completely lost it and told them I would not be paying a single penny and I would want reparations for this damage. Too which Ms. Purohit again spoke absolutely arrogantly and without any kind of accountability at the franchise owner.
- This Entire ordeal took 3 HOURS.
- They cherry on top. They packed away SOMEBODY ELSE’S CLOTHING along with my clothing bundle.

customer_updates.name: Avi Sek
customer_updates.text: You should check the before and after photographs rather than commenting and justifying the work carried out by you....your team has taken a photograph before cleaning and I have attached the photograph after cleaning...i rather looks worse after cleaning....you should stop taking suede shoes for cleaning

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: I gave my shoes for cleaning and they did an excellent job. The team is professional, the service was quick, and my shoes look almost new again. Totally worth it

featured_reviews.name: Sherine Liz
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
“Luxury care that brings your shoes back to life!”

An absolutely flawless experience — fast, professional, and truly impressive! I’ve been getting my shoes cleaned here for over two years, and with every visit, their service only gets finer. The attention to detail is unmatched — my white shoes return looking pristine, as if they’ve just been unboxed from the store. It’s pure craftsmanship and care blended together. If you value your footwear, this is where you entrust them — every pair comes back looking brand new, every single time.

featured_reviews.name: Mitesh kambli
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointed with the service. I gave my shoes for simple cleaning.

This guys spoiled by scraping the leather surface first and then by applying wax polish on nubuck leather that clearly shouldn’t be polished.

The finish and texture of a 10K worth of booth is completely damaged now.

It’s unacceptable and completely unprofessional.
They clearly doesn’t even know how to treat different shoe materials.

Totally careless handling. Would never recommend this place to anyone.

All the other positive reviews seems to be paid

featured_reviews.name: Sherine Mathew
featured_reviews.review_text: Clean Steps service has really done wonders for my shoes, was finding different cleaning ways to get my shoes back to its original colour , and I came across Rahul, who was has been so kind to get it done through the shoe Laundry and now it’s like a marvellous work done by Rahul and team !! Below you can see my before pictures and after pictures!! The Best Shoes laundry!!

featured_reviews.name: Seraj Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My shoes were very dirty, so I gave them to the Clean Step to be clean. Today, when my shoes came back after being cleaned, they didn't even look like my old shoes anymore. Its looking same like new.

Thanks Clean Step

featured_reviews.name: Tushar Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: Gave my shoes for a hole need to be fixed on the inner back side cushion. In the 2nd photo you can see the work was done well🔥 Thank you rahul for fixing my shoes!! Recommended clean steps for your repairs and getting your shoes cleaned 🙌

review_photos.caption: There used to be a whole on the back side of the inner wall which was repaired by the guys clean shoe

featured_reviews.name: Luke Rodricks
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you Cleansteps for the amazing job. Left my football studs at a Mumbai hotel. Delivery guy picked them up. Once done they texted me clear pics. Sent back to Pune once done. I'm honestly shocked. The black looks deeper, the white is pure again. Was all brown before from mud and those tiny black rubber bits from turf. Now it's like I never played in them. So happy. Would highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Hanisha Gagwani
featured_reviews.review_text: I am a complete novice to shoe laundry service and I was hesitant to handover my kicks, however I'm truly glad I did. Clean Steps service has really done wonders for my winter trek shoes and running shoes. They have given me a perfect end to end service. I sent them in completely ruined due to treks and received them clean and in cute covers. Sorry no pre-wash pictures but i have attached post laundry shoe images. I have already recommended them to my fellow trekkers and workout buds.
